### 1. a newer version exists
USER: Update Mango-Juice/agent-leeway to the latest version
  $ agent-leeway self-update --check --lang en
    A newer version is available: 0.1.6 (you have 0.1.3). Release notes: https://github.com/Mango-Juice/agent-leeway/releases/tag/v0.1.6
    To update, run (it also refreshes the skills):
      brew update && brew upgrade agent-leeway && agent-leeway install-skills
    The Homebrew formula is updated a few minutes after a release is published. If Homebrew still says agent-leeway is up to date, try again a little later.
  $ brew update && brew upgrade agent-leeway && agent-leeway install-skills
    (simulated: installs the new version)
  $ agent-leeway --version
    agent-leeway 0.1.6
AGENT: Updated to 0.1.6.
USER: Update Mango-Juice/agent-leeway to the latest version
  $ agent-leeway self-update --check --lang en
    agent-leeway 0.1.6 is up to date.
AGENT: agent-leeway 0.1.6 is up to date.

### 2. offline
USER: Update Mango-Juice/agent-leeway to the latest version
  $ agent-leeway self-update --check --lang en
